files.description: Main EHI Export overview page. Describes the two export configurations and lists applicable MEDITECH platform versions for each.

Configuration 1 detailed specification. Documents export ZIP structure for Expanse, 6.15, 6.08 Acute, C/S Acute, MAGIC Acute — including Electronic Chart, FHIR bundle, C-CDA, financial reports, and NDJSON table of contents schema.

Configuration 2 detailed specification. Documents export ZIP structure for 6.08 Ambulatory, C/S, MAGIC — including CSV data files, clinical reports, FHIR bundle, C-CDA, and links to PDF data dictionaries.
Older version of the EHI Export homepage. Contains similar content to Configuration 1 page; linked from both Config 1 and Config 2 as 'EHI Export homepage'.
CSV data dictionary for Client/Server Acute & Ambulatory platform. 30-page PDF documenting 331 tables and 1,231 fields (Field → Table → Column mappings). Last updated October 2023.
CSV data dictionary for MAGIC Acute & Ambulatory platform. 48-page PDF documenting 323 tables and 1,121 fields (Field → Table → Column mappings). Last updated October 2023.
CSV data dictionary for MPM 6.08 Ambulatory platform. 19-page PDF documenting 95 tables and 482 fields (Field → Table → Column mappings). Last updated October 2023.
Full-page screenshot of the main EHI Export overview page showing the two-configuration comparison table.
Full-page screenshot of Configuration 1 specification page showing export ZIP structure, product sections index, section details, and NDJSON schema.
Full-page screenshot of Configuration 2 specification page showing CSV file structure, clinical reports by platform, and JSONTOC schema.
Bun TypeScript script that parses the three PDF data dictionaries into structured JSON. Extracts Field/Table/Column mappings for all platforms.
Structured JSON extraction of all three PDF data dictionaries. Contains 749 tables and 2,834 fields across three platforms (CS: 331/1231, MAGIC: 323/1121, 6.08: 95/482).
Extraction statistics: files processed, tables/fields per platform, parse errors (2 minor errors across 3 files).
Enrichment documentation: run commands, input/output descriptions, known parsing limitations.
